matrix.title: Residual Risk Matrix
matrix.noData: No questionnaire or DORA data yet — control effectiveness defaults to 0%.
matrix.methodology: Inherent score = tier base + ICT function weights (DORA Art. 28). Control effectiveness = Q-score × 40% + gap coverage × 60%. Residual factor floor: 15% (risk is never fully eliminated). Formula is deterministic and auditable per Art. 28(3).

decision.title: Formal Risk Decision
